en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Abdul Rahman Bin Sayaba who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I borrowed a dog of the Magians, so I hunted with it. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not eat from its prey, except if a Muslims trains it, so it learns it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Mansur ibn Yunus from ‘Abd al- Rahman ibn Siyabah who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about my borrowing the dog of a Zoroastrian person for hunting.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Do not use it for food unless a Muslim has trained it and it has learned.’”
